name: emotion_context_eval_v0
description: Held-out controlled text stimuli for ASNE Dictionary Experiment v0. Labels are expected dictionary categories for evaluating predicted response similarity, not diagnoses or measurements of mental state.

items.text: A person waits near a bus stop while cars pass slowly through the evening traffic.
Someone opens a calendar, checks the date, and writes a short reminder for tomorrow.
A person notices a stranger standing too close as the hallway lights begin to flicker.
Someone hears glass break downstairs and freezes before deciding whether to call for help.
A person sits beside an empty chair and quietly remembers a friend who moved away.
Someone folds a letter slowly after reading that a familiar place will soon close.
A person receives two different addresses for the same appointment and cannot tell which one is correct.
Someone follows a set of instructions that skip a step and ends up unsure how to continue.
A person finds out the medical test was routine and lets out a long breath.
Someone reaches the platform just as the delayed train arrives and smiles with the pressure gone.
